rationale: Every AFBSTEP analysis is per-person. No other table can be interpreted without it.
Defines the window in which the absence of a record is interpretable. Without it a missing condition cannot be distinguished from an unobserved stretch of time.
Carries the baseline comorbidities and the study endpoints that are recorded as conditions.
Container for AF-burden assessment. One row per aggregated monitoring window or per disaggregated arrhythmia episode, distinguished by episode_type_concept_id.
Carries the numeric AF burden (percent time in AF) and the maximum rate during an episode. The study's primary quantity lives here.
Carries how the burden was assessed: estimation method, monitoring mode, analysable and AF-classified ECG counts, episode duration, symptomatic status.
Links an episode to the measurement and observation rows derived from it. Expected rather than mandatory because a site reporting only aggregated windows has nothing to disaggregate.
AFBSTEP extension recording the device and detection algorithm behind an episode. Expected because AF burden from intermittent ECG has no device to describe.
Links a person to the source study they were enrolled in. Not present for persons contributed outside any study context, e.g. standalone wearable data submissions.
Describes a source study contributing data. Absent when a partner submits data outside any study context, e.g. standalone wearable data.
AFBSTEP extension linking an episode to an externally stored raw file (report, waveform). Absent where the burden was derived purely from numeric assessment with no accompanying file.
